PAGE TITLE: MANAGEMENT’S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS - ANALYSIS OF SYSTEMS, CONTROLS, AND LEGAL COMPLIANCE
NASA Federal Managers’ Financial Integrity Act Annual Statement of Assurance Process (CONTINUED)

DIAGRAMS:
- Title: FIGURE 1 NASA FMFIA Annual Statement of Assurance Process
- Pyramid Diagram showing layers flowing upward to ADMINISTRATOR (top green arrow):
  - Layer 1 (bottom base): ANNUAL ASSESSMENT OF INTERNAL CONTROLS OVER PROGRAMS, OPERATIONS, FINANCIAL REPORTING & SYSTEMS
  - Layer 2: NASA OFFICIALS-IN-CHARGE/CENTER DIRECTORS/CFO ASSURANCE STATEMENTS
  - Layer 3: MANAGEMENT SYSTEM WORKING GROUP
  - Layer 4: SENIOR ASSESSMENT TEAM
  - Layer 5: MISSION SUPPORT COUNCIL
  - Top: ADMINISTRATOR

PHOTOS:
- Photo of Jupiter's volcanic moon Io, showing a yellowish-brown sphere with dark surface features/fractures.
- Caption: For Your Processing Pleasure: The Sharpest Pictures of Jupiter’s Volcanic Moon Io in a Generation. NASA’s Juno spacecraft just made the closest flybys of Jupiter’s moon Io that any spacecraft has carried out in more than 20 years... PHOTO CREDIT - NASA/JPL-Caltech/SwRI/MSSS Image processing by Emma Wälimäki

KEY FACTS:
- On Dec. 30, 2023, Juno came within about 930 miles (1,500 kilometers) of the surface of the solar system's most volcanic moon.
